info.title: dist-f2b controller REST API
info.description:
REST API of the dist-f2b controller, served over HTTPS only (default port 7444) under /api/v1.

Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer df2bapi1.<secret>` (API tokens: CLI, scripts), or the browser session cookie `__Host-df2b_session` from `POST /api/v1/session` or an OpenID Connect login. With a session cookie, every request other than GET/HEAD must send the session's CSRF token in `X-CSRF-Token` (returned by login and whoami). A bearer token takes precedence over a cookie.

Roles: viewer < operator (ban/unban) < admin; each operation states its minimum in `x-required-role` (`none`: unauthenticated, `authenticated`: any role).

Errors are JSON `{"error": "..."}`. Request bodies that are not valid JSON for the operation (syntax, unknown or missing fields, wrong types, missing `Content-Type: application/json`) and invalid query strings are rejected by the framework with 400/413/415/422 and a plain-text body. All of /api/ except /api/v1/health is subject to a per-client rate limit (429 with Retry-After).

This document is hand-written; a test in crates/df2b-controller/src/api.rs keeps its paths, methods and roles in sync with the router.

bearerToken.description: API token (created with `df2b-controller api-token create` or by an admin in the web UI).

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: The session's CSRF token; required with the session cookie for every method other than GET/HEAD.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input (the message says what). Malformed JSON, unknown fields, missing fields or a wrong Content-Type are rejected by the framework before the handler with 400/415/422 and a plain-text body.

Unauthorized.description: No or invalid credentials (missing/unknown/expired API token, malformed bearer token, expired session).

Forbidden.description: Role too low; or a session request without a valid X-CSRF-Token (unsafe methods); or a session whose temporary password must be changed first.

Conflict.description: Conflicts with the current state (the message says what).

TooManyRequests.description: Per-client request rate limit (token bucket; IPv6 per /64).

Error.description: Every API error (except the OIDC browser endpoints and request-body/query rejections by the framework, which are plain text).

IpNet.description: IP network in CIDR notation, host bits cleared; single addresses are /32 or /128.

Target.description: IP address or prefix (CIDR); host bits are cleared.

Asn.description: Autonomous system, "AS" or "as" followed by the number (not AS0).

Name.description: Letters, digits, - _ . @; at most 64 characters (users and API tokens share one name space; "oidc-provider" is reserved).

JailName.description: Letters, digits, - _ .; at most 64 characters (also used for rule, filter and redaction rule names).

Group.description: Agent group: letters, digits, - _ .; at most 64 characters.

Propagate.description: What an agent's local ban turns into: a global ban, a ban for the agent's group, or nothing.

Scope.description: Which agents a decision applies to (adjacently tagged).

value.description: Agent id, correlation rule name, or user / API token name.

Decision.description: An entry of the append-only decision log.

GeoInfo.description: GeoIP data; fields the databases do not know are left out.

lag_ms.description: How old the newest processed entry was (journald).

backlog_bytes.description: Bytes written but not read yet (files).

JailView.description: A jail as an agent reports it.

overridden.description: Settings that come from a central policy.

error.description: Why a central jail does not run.

redaction_version.description: "off": the agent does not accept central rules; "" = unknown.

resync.description: Present (true) only while a group change waits for the agent's next subscription.

Rule.description: A correlation rule as stored (max_bantime and asns are left out when unset).

asns.description: Only addresses in these autonomous systems; left out when empty (all addresses).

JailSettings.description: Policy settings; unset fields are left out (they keep what is below).

JailOverride.description: Stored jail policy (settings flattened into the object).

SourceDef.description: A log source of a central jail (tagged by type).

toml.description: Filter definition (TOML, like the agent's filter files).

id.description: Public session id (unrelated to the cookie secret).

actor.description: User / API token name, "agent:<id>" for enrollments, "oidc-provider" for provider logouts.

error.description: The last reload failed (the previous data is still used).

csrf_token.description: For sessions: the value to send in X-CSRF-Token.

key.description: Jail name, network, or origin string ("agent:<id>", "correlation:<rule>", "user:<name>").

new_password.description: 12 to 1024 characters, not the user name.

password.description: 12 to 1024 characters, not the user name.

temporary.description: The user must change it at the first login.

net.description: Address or prefix (at most /8 for IPv4, /16 for IPv6), or an autonomous system (its networks come from the GeoIP data).

comment.description: Control characters removed, at most 200 characters.

unban.description: Also lift active bans overlapping the entry.

ttl.description: Temporary entry, 1 minute to 30 days (e.g. "24h"); "never" or left out: permanent. Not allowed for autonomous systems.

JailPolicyRequest.description: Replaces the policy for the scope; unset fields keep what is below, all unset removes the policy.

group.description: Agent group; null, empty or left out: all agents.
Only this group's agents count and the ban applies to the group; null/empty: all agents, global ban.

bantime_factor.description: Repeat offenders: bantime x factor^(offense-1); default 1.

max_bantime.description: Duration, bantime to 10 years; null/empty: none.

monitor.description: Only record what would be banned.

asns.description: Only addresses in these autonomous systems (64500 or "AS64500"); at most 100; empty: all.

pattern.description: A rule to try; without one only the current rules apply.

name.description: The rule being edited (left out of the current rules, keeps its place).

toml.description: Filter definition (TOML); compiled before it is stored.

target.description: At most /8 for IPv4, /16 for IPv6; must not overlap the allowlist.

duration.description: Duration (e.g. "24h"); left out: permanent. The API enforces no bounds.

allow_for.description: Then keep the target from being banned again for this long (temporary allowlist entry): 1 minute to 7 days for operators, 30 days for admins; target at most /24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6).
